regions.name: Lagos mainland context
regions.note: Land continues between mainland districts through omitted urban areas. The envelope also includes lagoon water and is not a solid land rectangle.

regions.note: This deliberately broad envelope is not an LGA boundary. Akoka is a source-backed address anchor; the numeric extent is our estimate.

regions.name: Makoko / Iwaya land-water edge
regions.note: Keep land-based streets and water-supported structures distinct. A house on piles does not convert the water below it to land. The envelope does not establish today's settlement extent.

regions.name: Ikeja

regions.name: Lagos Island
regions.note: Distinct from Ikoyi as a district, but do not assume a wide unbroken channel between them. Envelope overlaps adjoining districts and water.

regions.name: Ikoyi
regions.note: District identity remains separate despite filled historical canal connections to Lagos Island. Current residual drains and reclamation boundaries need local mapping.

regions.name: Victoria Island / Oniru
regions.note: Keep Atlantic-facing and creek-facing edges distinct. Preserve land/road continuity toward Oniru and western Lekki rather than placing a made-up open-water gap in factual mode.

regions.name: Western Lekki Peninsula
regions.note: Lekki is a peninsula, not a detached real island. This western envelope is a bounded first authoring subset, not the entire Lekki/Epe landform. Never cap its eastern edge with sea in factual mode.

regions.name: Lekki Peninsula eastern continuation context
regions.note: Broad regional coverage window toward Epe and Ibeju-Lekki, not a traced peninsula boundary or a full-world generation request. Water and other land inside this window are not classified by this box.

nativePythonHandoff.consumer: json.load with standard Python; no engine import needed to read this document
nativePythonHandoff.reason: Current build_jobs selects existing canonical coverage IDs and require_handoff verifies pinned canonical sources. Additive geographic IDs are not in that coverage. Do not pass this manifest as an authorization, override an existing district job, or weaken References to accept external URLs.
steps: Read coordinateContract and choose the factual mode unless the fictional option has actual selection evidence
Use regions and sourceIds to bind authoring chunks, not to register destinations
Use bridgeCorridors only as mixed-evidence reference guides until road cross-section and complete alignment are delivered
Prepare explicit source-metre mesh vertices, triangle faces, materials and provenance in a separate native-authoring payload
Have the coordinator assign an authorized additive delivery path/job mechanism without replacing canonical jobs
Apply UE basis conversion once at native import and preserve existing scene placements

sourceLimitations: No contemporary authoritative shoreline vectors, district polygons, DEM or bathymetry obtained. Every district envelope is an explicit author estimate.
Mainland Central PDF was listed by the official directory but its 22878221-byte fetch exceeded the web limit. Its map content was not inspected.
The Works scorecard and University of Lagos island morphology source were available as indexed primary excerpts, not full documents.
The OSM API sample exposed five usable Third Mainland node positions. Full-way and other bbox requests were rate-limited; no full corridor extract or shoreline extract exists.
Older official plans and field studies do not establish October 2026 reclamation edges, built infrastructure, traffic closures or present settlement extent.
No current geolocated street-photo set, licensed texture set or photogrammetry collection was acquired. Named district envelopes alone do not meet the requested visual fidelity.
Snake Island and Banana Island are justified optional additions. Tarkwa Bay remains harbour-mouth context, not a fabricated detached island; unsupported proposed islands are excluded.
